Wipro Reports Q2 Results: Profit Declines Marginally, Revenue Grows

IT services company Wipro announced its second-quarter financial results, reporting a consolidated net profit of ₹3,200.6 crore, a marginal year-on-year decline of 1.9% to 4.7% quarter-on-quarter. The company's revenue for the September quarter rose 9.0% year-on-year to ₹24,752.7 crore, with a 1.1% sequential increase. The results were announced on a Thursday.
